title: Layout discovery: omni-deployer repo components
prompt:
Canonical corpus task (id t04, shape: project-layout discovery). In the omni-deployer repo (host path /opt/workspace/omni-deployer) report the repo-relative path of each of these five items, one numbered line per item:
1. The main deployment entry script.
2. The omnidev stack helper script.
3. The shared helper module imported by most scripts.
4. The one-shot cycle-gates SQL sheet added by the S12 gates-dashboarding task (lives under scripts/).
5. The directory that holds this canonical corpus.
Rules: bounded discovery only; use filesystem_search and filesystem_list (a handful of calls); confirm each candidate path exists with filesystem_info before you report it; do not read file contents; do not modify anything.
Expected final answer: exactly five numbered lines 'N. <repo-relative-path>' using paths relative to the repo root, for example 'scripts/cycle-gates.sql'. If you cannot confirm an item, still give your best path and append '(unverified)'.
note: Waste shape: project-layout discovery (E1/E4), second repo for stability statistics.
